entries.title: Bogomolov-Gieseker inequality for tilt-stable objects on threefolds
entries.statement: The conjectural Bogomolov-Gieseker type inequality holds for nu-tilt-stable objects on every smooth projective threefold.

entries.title: A variant of the Erdos discrepancy problem over function fields
entries.statement: Discrepancy of completely multiplicative sequences over function fields is unbounded.
